description_long: Jewish Telegraphic Agency reporting places Breitbart Jerusalem’s launch in November 2015, not January 2007. CEO Larry Solov said he and founder Andrew Breitbart discussed creating a media company during a 2007 trip to Jerusalem. The trip is part of the parent Breitbart News Network’s origin story; it is not the launch of the later Israel-focused publication. The supplied account also notes a separate political connection: Donald Trump appointed former Breitbart chair Stephen Bannon as his chief strategist in November 2016. That appointment does not show that Trump launched or directed Breitbart Jerusalem. The evidence therefore distinguishes three dates and events: the 2007 trip and discussion, the site’s 2015 launch, and Bannon’s 2016 appointment. The January 2007 title conflates the trip with the later site launch, while the supplied reporting does not connect Trump to the site’s creation. Solov’s account places the discussion at the company-building stage, years before Breitbart Jerusalem opened.
